milestones.title: Find animals by more names
milestones.description: We built a better species directory that understands scientific names, common names, and other known names. It's designed to keep saved species connected when the directory is updated.
milestones.benefit: Finding the right animal should be easier as we add more species data.
details: Search by scientific names, common names, or other names a species is known by.
Saved species links stay connected when the directory is refreshed.
More names can be added without changing your existing animal records.
milestones.action: No action needed. A larger species collection still needs a separate website update.

milestones.title: Making room for more kinds of pets
milestones.description: Care Keeper's animal tracking is being prepared for more than snakes, lizards, spiders, and scorpions. Your current animals and their histories keep working as before.
milestones.benefit: Dogs, fish, birds, frogs, and others can be added in future updates; they are not available to add yet.
details: Different animals can have different care needs. We made room for that.
Existing animals keep their profiles, care records, and familiar choices.
milestones.action: No action needed. Frogs, fish, birds, dogs, and cats are still for future updates.

milestones.title: More dependable care history
milestones.description: We improved how saved records are read when different actions happen close together, and prepared Care Keeper for new animal types without losing older records.
milestones.benefit: Fewer confusing errors when records change at the same time.
details: Made care records more dependable when several changes happen together.
Kept older records readable while preparing for more types of animals.
milestones.action: No action needed. Your existing care history stays in place.

milestones.title: Helpful care guides, with sources
milestones.description: Species pages gained clearer care information and a quick overview. When a guide is available, you can check its source instead of guessing where the advice came from.
milestones.benefit: Understand the available guidance and where it came from, without wading through long documents.
details: Read available care guidance and follow its sources.
Find species information in its own tab on an animal profile.
Shorter reference sections make the useful details easier to find on a phone.
milestones.action: Look for the species information tab on a linked animal when this update is available.

credit.creator: original: R. Bertani processing: P. Coxhead

milestones.title: Better tools for support
milestones.description: Trusted operators gained a way to review account and system problems without changing a keeper's records.
milestones.benefit: When something goes wrong, support can understand the problem without altering your animal history.
details: Support can check account and system problems in a read-only console.
Looking into a problem does not require editing your animal records.
milestones.action: No action needed. These tools are for authorized support staff.

milestones.title: A cleaner view of your care history
milestones.description: Routine technical entries are no longer mixed into the care history that you see for your animals.
milestones.benefit: Find feeding, cleaning, and other care records without unrelated background entries getting in the way.
details: Removed background stock entries from the care history shown to keepers.
Kept enclosure cleaning and water care visible where they belong.
milestones.action: No action needed. The clearer history uses your existing records.

milestones.title: Search for animals and plants
milestones.description: We added a species and plant directory, with suggestions when you type a name and the option to enter an animal manually if you can't find it.
milestones.benefit: Adding an animal can start with a name you know, even when a species isn't listed.
details: Find animal and plant species by typing a name.
Use a suggested species or enter an animal manually when it is missing.
Clearer species pictures and more compact cards help you browse.
milestones.action: Try a common or scientific name when adding an animal; manual entry remains available.

milestones.title: Know what supplies you have and what they cost
milestones.description: Inventory gained food and supply tracking, purchase history, stock counts, and reports to help you see what you're using and spending.
milestones.benefit: See when you're running low, keep counts accurate, and understand the cost of caring for your animals.
details: Record purchases and see how much food or other stock is left.
Correct supply counts when the shelf and the saved number differ.
Review spending by category and see whether costs are rising or falling.
milestones.action: Check your stock counts against what you have before relying on low-stock reminders.

milestones.title: Fix a care entry you made by mistake
milestones.description: We added a way to remove an incorrect care record from the normal view while keeping its change history safe.
milestones.benefit: Correct mistakes without losing the story of what happened.
details: Remove an incorrect care entry from the usual view.
Keep a record of the correction so the history still makes sense.
milestones.action: Only use the correction option for an entry that was recorded by mistake.

milestones.title: A fresh Care Keeper for phone and desktop
milestones.description: The application gained its current look, Today and Calendar views, Quick Log, easier navigation, charts, reports, and account tools.
milestones.benefit: Check what needs doing, record care quickly, and review your animals from a phone or computer.
details: See today’s care tasks or plan ahead in Calendar.
Use Add care to record a feeding, measurement, or other care quickly.
A clearer phone layout, wider desktop views, and easier photo uploads reduce extra steps.
Lizards and scorpions joined the animal choices, alongside snakes and spiders.
milestones.action: Use the navigation at the bottom on a phone, or the sidebar on a larger screen.

milestones.title: Spiders join the collection
milestones.description: Spiders gained their own care needs, including molting and premolt records, while sharing useful features such as feeding, photos, and reminders.
milestones.benefit: Keep track of a spider's care without pretending it needs exactly the same records as a snake.
details: Record molts and premolt signs as well as feeding and other care.
Reminders follow the animal’s care needs instead of treating every animal like a snake.
milestones.action: Choose the appropriate animal group when creating a profile.

milestones.title: Reminders, supplies, and expenses
milestones.description: Care Keeper gained care schedules, a list of what's due today or later, basic supplies, and expense tracking.
milestones.benefit: Keep important tasks together and get a clearer view of your care routine.
details: Set care schedules on individual animal profiles.
See what is due now and what is coming up.
Keep basic supplies and care expenses together.
milestones.action: Set a schedule that suits each animal, and review it when their needs change.

milestones.title: Animal profiles, photos, and enclosures
milestones.description: The first animal pages brought feeding notes, photographs, measurements, and enclosure moves together, with a history of corrections.
milestones.benefit: See an animal's story in one place and keep its care records organized.
details: Keep photographs, feeding notes, measurements, and enclosure moves in one profile.
Correct details while preserving earlier care history.
Later corrections kept decimal weights and lengths from being rounded away.
milestones.action: Add the measurements and photos you want to keep; existing records stay available.

milestones.title: Saving changes more reliably
milestones.description: We built the record-keeping foundation that helps Care Keeper keep history straight when details are corrected or updated.
milestones.benefit: Your existing care information has a more dependable history behind it.
details: Saved changes keep a clear history when details are updated.
Corrections preserve the earlier information instead of quietly replacing it.
milestones.action: No action needed. These improvements support the records you already keep.

milestones.title: Personal accounts and households
milestones.description: Care Keeper gained sign-in, account setup, and private household spaces.
milestones.benefit: Your collection can be kept separate from someone else's.
details: Create a personal account and a private household space.
Sign in to find your own collection and care records.
Later improvements added password recovery and clearer account controls.
milestones.action: Use your own account, and keep its sign-in details private.

milestones.title: The beginning of Care Keeper
milestones.description: Care Keeper began with a simple goal: a dependable place to organize animal care, ready for the profiles and care tools that followed.
milestones.benefit: The foundation for everything else in Care Keeper.
details: Created the first Care Keeper application.
Put the groundwork in place for profiles, care records, and the features that followed.
milestones.action: No action needed. This is where the Care Keeper story began.
